_method: In-session beat pass (targeted web search + article read per slate player), date-gated to the window. 'read' = human-quality classification that overrides keyword rules. Soft signals inform the Beat Intel lever and paragraph; they do NOT move the projection until the forward-grading loop earns their weight. Hard facts (OUT/LIMITED) gate now. Coverage rule: the pool's top-40 by pre-intel score (not the final slate), so intel can promote or demote near the recommendation floor.

items.title: Stevenson is the clear lead back; staff showed its preference in the playoffs (57% snap share vs Henderson 31%); 5.9 yds/touch; no injury concerns

read.note: Beat consensus has him as the clear lead back — the staff showed it in the playoffs (57% snap share vs Henderson's 31%) and he was 3rd in the league at 5.9 yards per touch; no health concerns (Yahoo, Aug 15). Henderson's explosiveness is the one long-term threat to the split.

items.title: Browns name Watson Week 1 starter over Shedeur Sanders; HC Todd Monken: 'gave us the best chance to move the ball'; 'not a week-to-week decision'; returned in preseason without noted restrictions after 2024 Achilles + two surgeries, missed all of 2025

read.note: Named the Week 1 starter by new HC Todd Monken ('not a week-to-week decision'), but this is a QB who missed all of 2025 after a 2024 Achilles tear and two surgeries — the beat notes no preseason restrictions, yet there is zero current-season data on him and a road opener in a new system (NFL.com, Aug 25). The model's recency read on him is stale by construction; the intel argues for caution, which is the side we're on.

items.title: Shaheed challenging Kupp for WR2; signed 3-yr/$51M in March signaling expanded plans; full offseason with Darnold; 55-yd TD connection in camp; 15 catches in 9 games after mid-2025 arrival

read.note: Mixed for an Under on catches: Seattle paid him (3-yr/$51M in March) and he's pushing Kupp for WR2 after a full offseason with Darnold — that says expanded role. But his archetype is the deep shot (1.7 catches a game last year, a 55-yard TD in camp), and deep threats pile up yards, not receptions (Heavy, Aug 12). The intel leans against the under; the archetype leans with it.

items.title: 'Literally unguardable' in 1-on-1s, tough red-zone catches; HC Liam Coen: 'I texted Parker... he was like, I'm ready to kill'; earliest to the facility; projects WR2 with primary-target capability, plays slot/X/outside
Brian Thomas Jr. exits practice with shoulder injury, coach says 'just precautionary'

read.note: The clearest 'coach loves him' read on the slate: Liam Coen quoted twice, beat writers calling him 'literally unguardable' in camp, projected WR2 with primary-target upside and slot/X/outside versatility (Yahoo, Aug 5). Brian Thomas Jr.'s precautionary shoulder exit only pushes more his way if it lingers.

items.title: Shoulder sprain in camp, downplayed, expected back within days; a coach: 'looks so fast', envisions screens and crossing routes; Rashee Rice on an extended ramp-up after a knee procedure, only recently in full team drills

read.note: Leans against our Under on catches: the early-August shoulder sprain was downplayed and is a month old, Rashee Rice is on an extended ramp-up after a knee procedure (targets cascade toward Worthy if Rice is limited), and the staff envisions him on screens and crossers — the high-catch-rate routes that pile up receptions (Yahoo, Aug 4).

items.title: Camp practice report: Geno Smith-Garrett Wilson connection; one-handed TD grab; chemistry building

read.note: Leans against our Under on catches: the Jets' camp reports are all Geno Smith-to-Wilson chemistry and highlight grabs — a clear WR1 with a new, accurate quarterback (Jets.com, Aug 7). Nothing in the beat suggests a reduced role.

items.title: Starters to play 8-12 preseason snaps minus Daniel Jones and Jonathan Taylor (rested); Steichen on Taylor's impact

read.note: Healthy — he sat the preseason finale as star rest alongside Daniel Jones, not injury, and Steichen's camp availability was about his impact (Colts.com, Aug 26). Mildly against our Under; the case for it is the Ravens' front, not anything about Taylor.
No confirmed in-window beat items — the search surfaced last summer's contract-dispute stories (he signed in Aug 2025), which are stale and excluded. Treat as no intel this week.

items.title: Lamar Jackson healthy and ready for Sept 13 opener; first-year OC Declan Doyle's new system; HC Jesse Minter; Zay Flowers sat with a minor injury (caution ahead of Week 1)

read.note: No Henry health notes, which for a 32-year-old back is good news, and Lamar is healthy. The real variable is structural: a new head coach (Jesse Minter) and a first-year OC (Declan Doyle) running a new system, so the goal-line and run-game tendencies we measured on last year's staff carry less weight (Ravens.com, Aug 26). Zay Flowers nursing a minor injury would tilt the offense further toward the run.

items.title: Goff talks the new offense under OC Petzing and Jameson Williams' development

read.note: Healthy and settled, but Detroit has a new offensive coordinator (Petzing), so the pass-rate tendency behind this Over is a new staff's, not the one we measured (Lions.com, Aug 20). A 2023 St. Brown/Williams injury story surfaced in search and was discarded as stale.

items.title: Herbert hits Quentin Johnston for a 65-yard TD in the preseason finale; Mike McDaniel's scheme in 2026

read.note: The Chargers are running Mike McDaniel's scheme this year — a pass-friendly, tempo offense — and Herbert looked sharp through camp, hitting Johnston for a 65-yard score in the preseason finale (Chargers.com, Aug 22). Supports the Over; the scheme change also means our measured Chargers tendencies are last staff's.

items.title: 65-yard TD from Herbert in the preseason finale; McDaniel scheme

read.note: Featured on the preseason finale's biggest play — a 65-yard touchdown from Herbert — in a McDaniel scheme built to push the ball downfield (Chargers.com, Aug 22). Supports the Over on yards; an old 'questionable' item surfaced in search and was discarded as undated.

items.title: Fully cleared, no limitations in joint practices; expected Week 1 starter; sat preseason opener by design; prior: sprained knee Wk 2 2025, severe dislocated elbow Wk 9 2025

read.note: Fully cleared with no limitations and the expected Week 1 starter (Covers, Aug 15) — but his last real game was Week 9 of 2025 (dislocated elbow), so our recency read on him is stale by construction. A healthy Daniels leans against an Under on yards; the case for it is a road trip to Philadelphia and his legs taking yards out of the air.

items.title: Penix positioned to potentially start Week 1 (sat the preseason finale; HC Kevin Stefanski: 'keeping it day-to-day'); with Penix last year London had a 56.6% target share over nine games; no injury concerns

read.note: The strongest read against a pick on the slate: with Penix under center last year London commanded a 56.6% target share, and Penix is trending toward starting while new HC Kevin Stefanski keeps it 'day-to-day' (LWOS, Aug 27). If Penix starts, an Under on yards is fighting a monster target share; if Tua's quick-release game starts instead, the under has a case. This pick is a QB-status call — confirm the starter before betting.

items.title: Kyren impressing in camp, 'honed in on training to be a running back'; Blake Corum 'agile and explosive' on the final camp day; McVay/Corum pressers

read.note: Camp reports have him sharp, but Blake Corum drew 'agile and explosive' notices on the final day and McVay keeps talking him up — a rising committee partner (Rams.com/CBS, Aug 10). That pressure is mostly on carries; for a receiving-yards Over at a low line, it's a minor drag.
Not searched this pass (QB rushing micro-prop) — no intel.
Not searched this pass (QB rushing micro-prop); the Jets' camp reports confirm he's the starter.

items.title: Camp closes: Lamb fully active, three TDs with Prescott in the final practice; Pickens-Prescott chemistry 'one of the more intriguing storylines of camp'

read.note: Fully healthy and sharp at the end of camp, but the storyline in Dallas is Prescott-to-Pickens chemistry — a genuine WR1B taking targets at the top (Yardbarker, Aug 27). Mildly supports an Under on his catches/yards; nothing here argues for a monster volume week.

items.title: Flowers has missed practice time with a lower-body injury; expected back in full next week and 'good to go' for Week 1 vs the Colts, per sources
Flowers sat practice with a minor injury; team being cautious ahead of Week 1

read.note: The 'more hurt than he says' case: a lower-body injury cost him practice time in late August; the beat expects him back in full and 'good to go' for Week 1, but he was not practicing fully as of Aug 28 (CBS/Zenitz; Ravens.com, Aug 26). Real caution on an Over — confirm a full practice week before betting.

items.title: Returning from ACL + meniscus (Week 4 last season) and a second scar-tissue procedure; in team drills since mid-August; has NOT committed to Week 1 vs Dallas; availability pending medical clearance

read.note: Back from an ACL and meniscus tear plus a second scar-tissue procedure; in team drills but not committed to Week 1 as of Sept 1, pending clearance (CBS). If he plays, a compromised first game supports an Under on catches; if he doesn't, the bet voids — a scratch risk, confirm active.

items.title: Pickens winning contested situations throughout camp; Prescott-Pickens chemistry a top camp storyline

read.note: The Dallas camp storyline was Prescott-to-Pickens chemistry, with Pickens winning contested balls all summer (Yardbarker, Aug 27). Leans against an Under on his catches.
